description: The Alberta environmental-assessment package describes the proposed Shell Jackpine Mine Expansion and Pierre River Mine about 100 km north of Fort McMurray. Source metadata states a combined oil-sands mining and bitumen-extraction production capacity of 300000 barrels per day and an assessment deemed complete in 2010. The 50 descriptors include project descriptions, environmental baseline and assessment documents, one DWG geology component and three CSV assay, collar and facies components. They are grouped as one project-assessment data collection. Descriptor names identify air-emission predictions and wildlife modelling, but model implementation and numerical outcomes are unverified. The proposed capacity is not evidence of construction or current operation. A specific simulation use is not assigned without further source evidence. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue provides descriptive metadata and exact original Alberta distribution identifiers. It labels the collection Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is through the linked descriptive record; current provider access and actual file downloads are untested. Costs are not stated. No document, workbook, archive or dataset body was fetched, and numerical contents have not been independently checked. Related editions and components are grouped only where the source identifies their relationship.
